description: v0.11.4 · operational health report for the rule store. Surfaces: rule count by severity, stale rules (last_verified > 90 days or null), pattern conflicts (two rules sharing an enforce_on category AND an identical regex pattern), recent check_action denials, and recent unreceipted destructive ops. Default returns pretty-printed text; pass {format: 'json'} for structured output. Run daily-ish · the report is fast and gives the operator a single view of what's drifting.
name: audit
